Read the following case study on survey data cleaning using Pandas and answer the questions that follow:

An educational research group conducts an online learning survey across 500 high school students. The survey responses are imported into a DataFrame survey_df containing columns: ['StudentID', 'StudyHours', 'DeviceType', 'InternetSpeed', 'ExamScore'].

The lead analyst identifies several data quality issues:

- Drops rows that have fewer than 3 valid non-null answers: survey_df.dropna(thresh=3, inplace=True)
- Imputes missing ExamScore with the mean exam score: survey_df['ExamScore'].fillna(survey_df['ExamScore'].mean(), inplace=True)
- Resets the index: survey_df.reset_index(drop=True, inplace=True)

options.text: Deletes all rows containing duplicate student names
